explanation: Q1 selects drinkers who never visit a bar serving a beer they don't like. Q2 selects drinkers who both like some beer at their frequented bars and dislike some beer at their frequented bars. These are logically distinct: Q1 includes drinkers with all liked beers at frequented bars, while Q2 includes drinkers with both liked and disliked beers at frequented bars.
